observations: Lint over-fires: 21/40 covered by frontmatter/self-description, 18/40 by in-body citation, only 1/40 truly orphaned (an operational '4.1 GB'). External-cite dominates (22), mostly dataset Ns and epi stats (prevalence, OR, p, %-surge) from inline author-year papers (Hou 2025, Sudre2024, Furgier2026) that para_has_citation regex misses. Structural (9) is pure noise: instrument model numbers (3000/6000), file sizes (Mb/GB), GCST-accession suffixes (543), entity-slug digits (0038/0011), config line numbers. Fixes: (a) resolve inline author-year and paper:/cite:/dataset: refs, not just formal cite tags; (b) whitelist accession suffixes, model numbers, sizes, entity slugs, line numbers; (c) exempt author-stipulated cutoffs and confidence values. Genuine orphan rate near zero.
